description: Fix leave module 500 errors by wrapping assertUserModuleAccess in try/catch and returning proper 403 responses instead of letting authorization errors bubble up as 500s. Pattern already exists in vault and journal routes.
steps: Read app/api/vault/upload/route.ts (lines 24-27) to see the correct try/catch pattern around assertUserModuleAccess
Wrap the assertUserModuleAccess(user, 'leave') call on line 19 in GET handler with try/catch, return apiError('FORBIDDEN', 'Access denied to Leave module', 403) in catch block
Wrap the assertUserModuleAccess(user, 'leave') call on line 105 in POST handler with the same try/catch pattern
Wrap the assertUserModuleAccess(user, 'leave') call on line 230 in DELETE handler with the same try/catch pattern
Wrap the assertUserModuleAccess(user, 'leave') call on line 277 in PATCH handler with the same try/catch pattern
acceptance_criteria: All four route handlers (GET, POST, DELETE, PATCH) have try/catch around assertUserModuleAccess
When leave module is disabled for a guest user, the API returns HTTP 403 with error message 'Access denied to Leave module'
No error stack traces appear in server logs for module access denials
Authorized users can still access the leave endpoints successfully
verification: Make a GET request to /api/mobile/v1/leave?year=2026 as a guest user with leave module disabled
Confirm response is 403 with { success: false, error: { code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Access denied to Leave module' } }
Check server logs - should see no error stack traces for authorization failures
Run 'bun test' to ensure no regressions in existing tests
findings: All four route handlers (GET, POST, DELETE, PATCH) in app/api/mobile/v1/leave/route.ts now properly wrap assertUserModuleAccess calls in try/catch blocks and return HTTP 403 with apiError('FORBIDDEN', 'Access denied to Leave module', 403) when access is denied. This matches the pattern used in vault/upload/route.ts. All leave-related tests pass. The 5 failing tests in the test suite are unrelated CalendarService Sync integration tests.
